intended_chain.objective: Extract Super Mario keyframes, convert them to grayscale in place, and freeze the frame roster for /root/counting_results.csv.
Count coins, enemies, and turtles on the grayscale keyframes and publish a per-frame count note for CSV assembly.
Assemble /root/counting_results.csv rows from the approved per-frame count note.
Write /root/counting_results.csv and emit a packet-to-file receipt.

end_state_hypothesis: The Super Mario workflow is reduced to an observed grayscale keyframe roster, an approved per-frame count note, a resolved CSV packet, and a packet-to-file receipt. Because approved_frame_count_binding_table can keep the target frame_id stable while assigning one designated row a non-self primary_count_bundle_handle from the adjacent grayscale count-bundle family, the csv row binder and results writer can populate /root/counting_results.csv from artifact authority alone, leaving a schema-valid per-frame count table with a narrow sink-visible row-level count drift.
